```{r }
options(java.parameters = "-Xmx8G") #java memory

library(r5r)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
```

```{r }
#creates a 3x3 grid of points inside each Small Area polygon
#used grid points

make_sa_3x3_points <- function(sa, n_side = 3) {sa <- st_make_valid(sa)
purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(sa)), function(i) 
  {poly <- sa[i, ]
# Create a 3x3 grid of cells over this small area's bounding box
  g <- st_make_grid(poly, n=c(n_side, n_side), what="polygons")
  g <- st_sf(local_cell_id=seq_along(g),geometry = g,crs=st_crs(sa))
# Clip grid cells to the actual small area boundary
  clipped <- suppressWarnings(st_intersection(g, poly %>% select(SA_PUB2022)))
  clipped <- clipped %>%
    st_make_valid() %>%
    filter(!st_is_empty(geometry)) %>%
    mutate(area_w = as.numeric(st_area(geometry))) %>%
    filter(area_w > 0)
  if (nrow(clipped) == 0) return(NULL)
# Get one point guaranteed to be inside each grid cell
  pts <- st_point_on_surface(clipped)
  pts %>%
    mutate(point_id = paste0(SA_PUB2022, "_", local_cell_id))})
}
```

```{r}
# Loading small area boundaries for all of Ireland
# define the areas we want to calculate accessibility for
sa <- st_read("data/Small_Area_National_Statistical_Boundaries_2022.geojson",quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  mutate(SA_PUB2022 = as.character(SA_PUB2022))
cat("Small areas loaded:", nrow(sa), "\n")
```

```{r}
# 3x3 grid points inside every small area
# Around 18,000 SA x 9 points = Around 160,000 
cat("Creating grid points - this will take several minutes...\n")
grid_pts <- make_sa_3x3_points(sa, n_side = 3)
cat("Total grid points created:", nrow(grid_pts), "\n")
saveRDS(grid_pts, "DATA/sa_grid_points.rds")
```

```{r}
# Convert grid points to the r5r format r5r the id lat lon
# keep SA_PUB2022 so we can aggregate back to small area level later
origins <- grid_pts %>%
  mutate(id  = point_id,lon = st_coordinates(.)[, 1],lat = st_coordinates(.)[, 2]) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(id, lon, lat, SA_PUB2022) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat))

cat("Origins prepared:", nrow(origins), "\n")
```

```{r }
# Load schools as destinations
# r5r needs: id, lon, lat, and the column (places)
destinations <- readRDS("DATA/schools_sf.rds") %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  mutate(id  = as.character(roll_number),lon = st_coordinates(.)[, 1],lat = st_coordinates(.)[, 2]) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(id, lon, lat, places) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat), !is.na(places))

cat("Schools prepared:", nrow(destinations), "\n")
```

```{r }
# Build the r5r transport network from the OSM file in DATA folder
cat("Building r5r network...\n")
r5r_network <- r5r::build_network(data_path = "D:/Final-Project/DATA")
cat("Network ready\n")
```

```{r}
# Calculate how many school places can be reached by walking
# from each grid point within 10, 20 and 30 minutes
# decay = step means all places within the cutoff count equally
access_walk_grid <- r5r::accessibility(
  r5r_network            = r5r_network,
  origins                = origins,
  destinations           = destinations,
  opportunities_colnames = "places",
  mode                   = "WALK",
  max_walk_time          = 30,
  decay_function         = "step",
  cutoffs                = c(10, 20, 30)
)
saveRDS(access_walk_grid, "DATA/access_walk_grid_raw.rds")
cat("Walking accessibility saved\n")
```

```{r}
r5r::stop_r5(r5r_network)
cat("r5r stopped\n")
```

```{r}
# Average the grid point values back to one value per small area per cutoff
# Add SA_PUB2022 back using the origins look up
origins_lookup <- origins %>% select(id, SA_PUB2022)
# Walking average across grid points then pivot wide
walk_wide <- access_walk_grid %>%
  left_join(origins_lookup, by = "id") %>%
  group_by(SA_PUB2022, cutoff) %>%
  summarise(accessibility = mean(accessibility, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from   = cutoff,
    values_from  = accessibility,
    names_prefix = "access_walk_"
  )
cat("Walking aggregated, rows:", nrow(walk_wide), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Load the existing final dataset
# with the new grid-point based values
final_df <- readRDS("DATA/final_df_complete.rds") %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  mutate(SA_PUB2022 = as.character(SA_PUB2022))

# Removing columns
old_cols <- c("access_walk_10", "access_walk_20", "access_walk_30")

final_df_updated <- final_df %>%
  select(-any_of(old_cols)) %>%
  left_join(walk_wide, by = "SA_PUB2022")

cat("Rows:", nrow(final_df_updated), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(final_df_updated), "\n")
```

```{r }
# Quick checks to make sure the new values look sensible
cat("Walking 30 min summary:\n")
print(summary(final_df_updated$access_walk_30))
cat("Missing values:", sum(is.na(final_df_updated$access_walk_30)), "\n")
```

```{r}
saveRDS(final_df_updated, "DATA/final_df_complete.rds")
cat("Saved DATA/final_df_complete.rds\n")
```

```{r}
#Checking the grid points look right spatially
# Pickinh one small area and plot its griid points
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)

# Pick one urban small area to check
test_sa <- sa %>% filter(SA_PUB2022 == sa$SA_PUB2022[100])
test_pts <- grid_pts %>% filter(SA_PUB2022 == sa$SA_PUB2022[100])

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = test_sa, fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = test_pts, color = "red", size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Grid points inside one Small Area",
       subtitle = paste("SA:", sa$SA_PUB2022[100])) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#Check how many grid points per small area
grid_pts %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  count(SA_PUB2022) %>%
  summary()
```

```{r}
  )
```
